description: FREE, no key: the Taifoon venue's 24 h statistics for one market as the venue computes them: volume, quote volume, trade and fill counts, high, low, open, close, change in percent, and the venue clock with the reading's age. Venue figures (Taifoon devnet book, synthetic actors), never an exchange's: say 'venue book'.

market.description: a tape market (NQ, ES, YM, BTC, ETH, SOL, ICP, BLESS) or any book the venue serves: its twin markets and spot books (GET https://api.taifoon.dev/book/v1/markets) and its futures contracts, micros included (GET https://api.taifoon.dev/book/v1/futures/contracts)

name: book_stats
